name: C
ecosystem_note: Keep a project-level LICENSE file; headers are useful for individual source files and generated C headers.

name: C++
ecosystem_note: Apply the chosen identifier consistently across templates, headers, and compiled library sources.

name: C#
ecosystem_note: For NuGet packages, also publish the license expression or license file metadata required by the package format.

name: Java
ecosystem_note: Maven and Gradle metadata should agree with the repository LICENSE and any bundled dependency notices.

name: Python
ecosystem_note: Publish the license in project metadata and include it in source distributions and wheels when appropriate.

name: JavaScript
ecosystem_note: Keep package.json license metadata, source headers, and bundled third-party notices aligned.

name: TypeScript
ecosystem_note: Check both TypeScript source and generated JavaScript distribution artifacts for notice handling.

name: Go
ecosystem_note: Go modules can include dependencies with different licenses; audit go.mod and transitive modules.

name: Rust
ecosystem_note: Cargo.toml license or license-file metadata should match the source and distribution terms.

name: PHP
ecosystem_note: Composer package metadata and bundled dependencies should be checked separately.

name: Ruby
ecosystem_note: Gem metadata, gemspec files, and vendored dependencies may have separate notice obligations.

name: Swift
ecosystem_note: Swift Package Manager manifests should describe the same license choice as the repository.

name: Kotlin
ecosystem_note: Review Gradle dependency reports and packaged NOTICE files for Android and JVM distributions.

name: Dart
ecosystem_note: pubspec metadata and Flutter release bundles should preserve third-party license notices.

name: R
ecosystem_note: CRAN package DESCRIPTION metadata and installed source files should use compatible terms.

name: Lua
ecosystem_note: Include the license in rockspec or package metadata when publishing a reusable module.

name: Perl
ecosystem_note: CPAN metadata, module headers, and bundled modules can carry different licenses.

name: Haskell
ecosystem_note: Cabal or Hackage metadata should remain consistent with source and distribution files.

name: Scala
ecosystem_note: sbt or Maven publication metadata should include license and NOTICE information.

name: Objective-C
ecosystem_note: Framework bundles and CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager metadata may need separate notice handling.
